(Availability Coming Soon!) Augusta, Georgia plays host to the first major of each season in golf. Come April, fans are referred to as patrons and tickets are known as badges, as the world’s top players gather to compete for the coveted green jacket. The course, Augusta National Golf Club was founded by Bobby Jones and Clifford Roberts, who began hosting the tournament for the first time in 1934. Since 1940, the tournament has been held the first week of April and remains the only major in golf that does not change venues each year.
